title: Item Quality Colors
content: An item's name is colored by its quality: grey is poor, junk sold to vendors; white is common; green is uncommon; blue is rare; purple is epic; orange is legendary; and light gold marks bind-to-account heirlooms. Higher quality means better stats for the item level, and purple gear mostly comes from heroics and raids.

title: Tier Sets
content: Each class's tier set gives a bonus at 2 and at 4 pieces worn. Wrath has Tier 7 from Naxxramas, Tier 8 from Ulduar, Tier 9 from Trial of the Crusader and Tier 10 from Icecrown Citadel. Tier 9 is bought with Emblems of Triumph and Tier 10 with Emblems of Frost, then upgraded with Marks of Sanctification from ICC bosses.

title: Profession Tools
content: Some professions need a tool in the bags before their recipes work: blacksmiths a Blacksmith Hammer, engineers an Arclight Spanner, enchanters a runed rod matched to their skill, miners a Mining Pick and skinners a Skinning Knife. Smithing and smelting also need you standing beside an anvil or a forge. Crafting never fails.

title: Weapon and Armor Enchants
content: Enchanters apply enchants directly or onto a scribe's Armor or Weapon Vellum to make a tradeable scroll; ring enchants are for the enchanter only. Popular Wrath weapon enchants are Berserking and Mongoose for melee, Black Magic for casters and Accuracy for hit. Death knights use Runeforging instead, like Rune of the Fallen Crusader or Razorice, at a runeforge in Ebon Hold.

expert_content: Weapon: Berserking for most melee, Black Magic for casters, Mongoose for agility classes, Massacre on two-handers, Blade Ward or Blood Draining for tanks. Chest takes Powerful Stats. Cloak takes Major Agility for physical damage, Greater Speed for casters, and Mighty Armor for tanks. Leatherworkers' Icescale Leg Armor and tailors' Sapphire or Brilliant Spellthread are the leg enchants to get.

title: Socketed Gems
content: Sockets are red, yellow, blue or meta. Red gems carry strength, agility, attack power or spell power; yellow carry crit, haste or hit; blue carry stamina, spirit or mana regen; orange, purple and green count as both colors. Matching every socket turns on the item's socket bonus, and a meta gem works only if you meet its color requirement.

title: Consumable Items
content: You can have one battle elixir and one guardian elixir active, or a flask, which counts as both and lasts an hour through death. Only one potion can be drunk per fight, such as a Runic Healing or Runic Mana Potion at 80, and a Well Fed food buff stacks with all of it.

expert_content: Raid with a flask rather than two elixirs: it lasts through death and costs less. Use Endless Rage, Frost Wyrm, Stoneblood or Pure Mojo depending on role. Fish Feast covers food for the whole raid. Drink a damage potion just before the pull and another during the fight, since the potion cooldown waits until combat ends.

title: Trade Goods and Materials
content: Trade goods are crafting materials: cloth drops from humanoids (Frostweave in Northrend), leather comes from skinning beasts (Borean Leather), ore from mining (Cobalt, Saronite, Titanium) and herbs from herbalism. Eternals and Frozen Orbs go into high-end crafts. Gatherers make steady gold selling them on the auction house.

title: Guild and Faction Tabards
content: Tabards are cosmetic chest-overs. A guild designs its tabard at a guild tabard vendor, and members wear it to show the emblem. title: Cosmetic Items
content: There is no wardrobe or appearance-change system yet -- an item's look is simply whatever is equipped, so cosmetic collecting mostly means non-combat companion pets, which follow a player around and do nothing else. Pets are earned from vendors, quest rewards, holiday events, and rare drops, and many players collect them purely for their own sake. Some weapon enchants add a visual glow or proc animation as a side effect of their stat bonus, which is the closest thing to a customizable weapon appearance available this expansion. Holiday events also hand out costume items, like Hallow's End's wand that temporarily transforms the user into a ghost, ninja, pirate, skeleton, or leper gnome.

content: Paladins, druids, shamans and death knights carry a relic in the ranged slot instead of a ranged weapon: librams for paladins, idols for druids, totems for shamans and sigils for death knights. Each boosts specific class spells, so the right one depends on spec.

title: Mithril Bars
content: No vendor sells Mithril Bars and no creature drops them: you smelt them from Mithril Ore, one ore per bar, at a forge with Smelt Mithril, which a mining trainer teaches at skill 175 for 50 silver. Mithril Deposits need 175 Mining and are common in the Hinterlands, Searing Gorge, Arathi Highlands, Desolace, Felwood, Alterac Mountains, Stranglethorn Vale, Tanaris and the Badlands. Otherwise buy bars at the auction house.

title: Badge of Justice
content: Badge of Justice is the Burning Crusade gear currency. It drops from Outland heroic dungeon bosses and from raid bosses from Karazhan to the Sunwell Plateau, and the heroic Wanted daily quests pay 2. It is spent in Shattrath City with G'eras, Anwehu and Ontuvo, and on the Isle of Quel'Danas with Kayri. Nothing in Northrend drops it: Emblems of Triumph and Frost took over there.

It is a very fast ground mount that carries three riders and vendors.
